questions.prompt: Which dynasty built the majority of the Great Wall that survives today?
questions.fact: Earlier walls were rammed earth; the brick and stone sections tourists visit are mostly from this later period.

questions.prompt: What is the smallest unit of an element that retains its properties?
questions.fact: The name comes from a Greek word meaning uncuttable, which turned out to be wrong by about two thousand years.

questions.prompt: In rugby union, how many points is a try worth?
questions.fact: It was worth nothing at all originally, merely earning the right to try a kick at goal, which is where the name comes from.

questions.prompt: Which show features chemistry teacher Walter White?
questions.fact: The creator originally pitched it as taking the protagonist from a sympathetic figure to an antagonist across the run.

questions.prompt: Which country is landlocked and borders both France and Italy?
questions.fact: It has not fought a foreign war since 1815, though military service remains compulsory for most men.

questions.prompt: Which novel introduced the character Hester Prynne?
options: The House of the Seven Gables
questions.fact: The author was descended from a judge at the Salem witch trials, and added a letter to his surname to distance himself.

questions.prompt: Which file format is a lossy image compression standard?
questions.fact: Each save discards a little more detail, so repeatedly editing and resaving the same file visibly degrades it.
